(385185) 1993 RO
is a
plutino
. It was the first plutino discovered after
Pluto
itself, with
1993 RP
and
(15788) 1993 SB
a day and two days later, respectively. The discovery was made in 1993 at the
Mauna Kea Observatory
with a 2.2-meter telescope. Very little is known about 1993 RO. The diameter estimate of ~90 km is based on the assumed albedo of 0.09.
[
2
]
Other Kuiper belt objects discovered in 1993 include
(15788) 1993 SB
,
(15789) 1993 SC
, and
(181708) 1993 FW
.
